text.text_excerpt: I used to go to the joint which was here previously and heard another place opened after they moved. I am all about supporting new business so was in the area and decided to stop and check it out. Am I ever glad I did. They were a little slow so I got a chance to talk with the couple that reopened the place. They are an awesome couple. Living the American dream openeing a new place and working hard to make it work. K, now on to the food. The menu was one sided so it was not very hard to make a decision. Another customer there suggested I get the cheese steak but said all the menu items are just as good. This was the best cheese steak I have ever eaten. I could tell ALL of the ingredients ...

Jughead's is located in the old building where The Joint use to be so it has big shoes to fill. As a matter of fact, I only stumbled upon this place when the girlfriend and I tried to go to The Joint on Friday night(9/14/12) but the line was crazy long. So we wandered over here since I saw on a sign that they had cheesesteak sandwiches. We walked in and there was not a single person inside. There was a sign at the counter that said "order at the bar on the back patio". So that we did. There was a bartender there and only 3-4 other people outside hanging out. The menu was very small with only 4-5 options; the cheese steak, a chicken sandwich and a few salads. No matter, I wanted the cheese...
Cheese-steak and a couple of beers. Felt like I was invited to someone's backyard party. Perfect for a low key night when you just want good food with a quiet atmosphere.
